findings.title: Missing Homogenbereich specification
findings.message: The description "Boden lösen und profilgerecht ausheben" lacks the required Homogenbereich designation (e.g., B1, B2) as per VOB/C § 4.2.1 and DIN 18300. Without this, the extent of the excavation and the associated geotechnical risk remain unclear.
findings.suggestion: Add a Homogenbereich reference and depth limits, e.g., "Boden gemäß Homogenbereich B1, Aushubtiefe bis 3,00 m".

findings.title: Missing thermal conductivity and thickness details
findings.message: The term "Wärmedämmplatten" is insufficient; the specification must include the material type, thickness, and thermal conductivity (WLS) as required by VOB/C § 4.2.1 and DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Specify e.g., "Wärmedämmplatten aus XPS, d = 100 mm, WLS 035".

findings.title: Missing water exposure class
findings.message: The phrase "Abdichtung erdberührter Bauteile" omits the mandatory water exposure class (W1–W4) and the type of membrane, as per VOB/C § 4.2.1 and DIN 18533.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "Abdichtung erdberührter Bauteile mit PMBC, Wassereinwirkungsklasse W1.2-E".

findings.title: Unspecified scope of site preparation
findings.message: "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" is vague; it does not define the required site facilities, safety measures, or duration of maintenance. This could lead to disputes over what is included in the lump sum.
findings.suggestion: Detail the necessary site facilities, safety equipment, and specify the period of maintenance, e.g., "Baustelle mit Sicherheitsabgrenzung, Gerüst, und Staubschutz für die gesamte Bauzeit".

findings.title: Ambiguous frost protection specification
findings.message: "Frostschutzmaterial liefern und nach Vorgabe einbauen" lacks the required frost protection class, material type, and installation depth. This may result in non-compliance with VOB/C § 4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Specify e.g., "Frostschutzmaterial (z. B. Frostschutzschicht aus Styropor, d = 50 mm, WLS 040) nach DIN 18331".

findings.title: Missing connection details for PE-HD pipe
findings.message: The description does not state the required connection type, joint material, or pressure class, which are mandatory under VOB/C § 4.2.1 and DIN 14671.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "PE-HD Rohr DN 150, Druckklasse 16 bar, mit Verbindungsteilen aus PE‑HD, DIN 14671".

findings.title: Incomplete shaft construction details
findings.message: "Schacht DN 1000 aus Betonfertigteilen herstellen" omits shaft dimensions, reinforcement details, and concrete class, which are required by VOB/C § 4.2.1 and DIN 1045.
findings.suggestion: Specify e.g., "Schacht DN 1000, Länge 4 m, Betonfertigteile C25/30, Bewehrung gemäß DIN 1045".

findings.title: Missing concrete mix details
findings.message: The specification references DIN EN 206 and DIN 1045 but does not state the concrete mix design, slump, or curing regime, which are essential for quality control.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "Beton C25/30, Mischverhältnis 1:2:4, Schüttung 20 cm, Nachbehandlung 7 Tage".

findings.title: Missing mortar class and reinforcement details
findings.message: "Mauerwerk KS 17,5 cm" does not specify the mortar class (e.g., KS 17,5 cm), reinforcement, or load-bearing classification, which are required by VOB/C § 4.2.1 and DIN 1045.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "Kalksandsteinmauerwerk KS 17,5 cm, Bewehrung gemäß DIN 1045".

findings.title: Missing plaster finish details
findings.message: "Innenputz als einlagigen Putz" lacks the required plaster type, thickness, and finishing method per VOB/C § 4.2.1 and DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Specify e.g., "Innenputz, einlagig, 10 mm, aus Zementputz, glatt verputzt".

findings.title: Missing edge insulation details
findings.message: "Zementestrich einschließlich Randdämmstreifen" does not define the edge insulation material, thickness, or installation method, which are required by VOB/C § 4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "Randdämmstreifen aus XPS, 50 mm, mit Schweißverbindung".

findings.title: Missing paving specifications
findings.message: "Betonpflaster liefern, verlegen und verfugen" omits the required paving size, joint width, and surface treatment per VOB/C § 4.2.1 and DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Specify e.g., "Betonpflaster 300 mm × 300 mm, 10 mm, mit 5 mm Schweißfugen".

findings.title: Missing asphalt layer specifications
findings.message: "Asphalttragschicht" requires specification of binder type, aggregate gradation, and compaction parameters per VOB/C § 4.2.1 and DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "Asphalttragschicht, Bindemittelform 60 %, Gradierung 0–10 mm, Verdichtung 3 × 5 mm".

findings.title: Missing asphalt deck specifications
findings.message: "Asphaltdeckschicht" lacks binder, aggregate, and compaction details required by VOB/C § 4.2.1 and DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Add e.g., "Asphaltdeckschicht, Bindemittelform 70 %, Gradierung 0–15 mm, Verdichtung 4 × 5 mm".
